_note: Narration script for the Team Leader team page module (Team Leader guide section 9, Team pages: banner photo and photo slides). Written by Claude from the guide, for the owner to review. Lee voice on eleven_v4, [calmly] prefix, two takes (scenes 1 to 4, then 5 to 8). DSY spelled D S Y, JPG and PNG as letters, WebP 'web P', 10 MB 'ten megabytes' in the prompt.

lines.head: Introduction
sentences: Your team page.
It's what your crew sees when they sign in.

lines.head: What's on it
sentences: A banner photo behind the team name.
The training schedule and Learn on your own buttons.
Photo slides to swipe through.
And About the team, with your links.

lines.head: Open the editor
sentences: Open your team's page, and tap Edit this page.
Or, on the Region page, tap Edit page on the team's tile.

lines.head: Banner photo
sentences: Choose a banner photo.
It replaces the town photo DSY put there.
Wrong part showing? Drag the Move the photo slider.
It saves when you let go.

lines.head: Photo slides
sentences: Add photo slides. You can choose more than one.
Give each one a caption, if you like.
Move up changes the order, and Remove takes one out.

lines.head: Words and links
sentences: About this team, the roster link and your links are in the same form.
Tap Save team page for those.
Photos save as soon as they upload.

lines.head: Photos to use
sentences: Photos must be JPG, PNG or WebP, up to 10 MB each.
Only use photos you took, or have permission to use.
And check that crews and patients are happy to be in them.

lines.head: Summary
sentences: A good banner.
A few slides.
And the words your crew need.
